title: Add to Quicklaunch addon possibility to move icons not only out, but also in
line: Dragging a file or desktop link onto the Quicklaunch widget now adds it as a launcher.
explanation: Since dragging an icon out no longer removes it, the remaining half of this bug was that nothing could be dropped back in: the widget showed the drop marker, but on release no launcher was added. The drop handler kept event.mimeData.urls and inserted it in a Qt.callLater callback; by then the drag's mime data was gone and the saved list was empty (logged: ["file:///…/systemsettings.desktop"] in onDrop, [] in the callback). The change copies the URLs into a plain array before deferring, in the panel grid and in the popup.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: keep dropped URLs until they are inserted

Dropping a file or link from outside onto Quicklaunch added nothing, since
the URL list read from the drop event was only used after the drop ended,
when it had become empty. Copy the URLs into an array before deferring.

BUG: 363651

media.caption: Dragging the System Settings desktop link onto the Quicklaunch (Konsole, Dolphin) in the panel
After the drop: nothing was added
After the drop: System Settings is added as a third launcher
